notes.title: Hatchwell QoL Improvements update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/d72a079c5cd8e7e05a5c62ecfb39ad7c313672de.png[/img]

This last couple weeks was spent working on your feedbacks and today, I am happy to announce that version 2 is out! 


Version 2 includes Quality of Life improvements such as:

[b]PLAY STYLE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/44617655dcc40d029411c74e4576906f40e16d77.png[/img]
You'll now be able to adjust the Play Style that you think is best for you when playing Hatchwell! You can adjust these anytime in the Settings Menu in game!


[b]NEW MENU![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/14d60b4d71c6ace3595509897e1cd9e55cb95c38.png[/img]
The updated new look of the game's Menu includes a Quality of Life improvements as well! If you have already played the game prior to this update, you'll be welcomed with a nice quick info to tour you around!


[b]SAVE WITH A KEY[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/a73ecbc8f42aa4cbc2053ccfc9cf23cadbf902e0.png[/img]
The Menu is now updated, moving a few things around. SAVING is now attached to a single button that you can press for easy access!


[b]QUEST LOG AT A TIME[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/949c547245e8a437041eed3a84923e84c1256a11.png[/img]
Since time is moving in Hatchwell, so are the Townspeople! The Quest log in the Menu now enables you to see available quests at a certain time. 


[b]QUEST INDICATOR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/8abb5b85c66903357f5fa362e3a1cfc0c9d39d37.png[/img]
Townspeople with Side Quests are now indicated by a "?" above their heads! They are time limited as well! 



[b]TIME MOVES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416665/bf8b90160a19982661a38457c0538820efa129af.png[/img]
A NOTICE that time will move forward when...they move forward. So you'll have time to complete Time Limited Quests



[b]OTHER UPDATES[/b]
For other updates, you can check the Update notes here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1424690/view/3372647018503926624


Again, thank you soo much for playing the game!
- Adee

tags.feature: You'll now be able to adjust the Play Style that you think is best for you when playing Hatchwell!
The updated new look of the game's Menu includes a Quality of Life improvements as well!
SAVING is now attached to a single button that you can press for easy access!
The Quest log in the Menu now enables you to see available quests at a certain time.
Townspeople with Side Quests are now indicated by a "?" above their heads!

notes.title: Hatchwell v2.0.0
notes.content:
Hatchwell v2.0.0

Patch Notes and Improvements:
- Added a note of “time moving forward” when before entering dungeon 4 and when taking gems
- Added an indicator on top of optional non-main story NPCs that have a story/errand to ask of you.
- Added ability to change play style (can reduce or turn off enemy respawning, have lesser or more enemy drops chance) when starting a New Game and in Menu Settings for real time change.
- Made the “Save Game” accessible anywhere in the Menu with a dedicated button
- Added Quest log in the menu, it lists available quests at a certain period. Also indicating whether it’s a Normal quest, or a Limited quest.
- Added a way to purchase bombs and keys prior to the final boss, enabling players to complete all the collectibles in the game!
- Reduced the purple balls that shoot at you during the first dungeon boss fight.
- Route Puzzles are now saved in game so you won’t have to re-do them when you go through the dungeon.

tags.feature: - Added a note of “time moving forward” when before entering dungeon 4 and when taking gems
- Added an indicator on top of optional non-main story NPCs that have a story/errand to ask of you.
- Added ability to change play style (can reduce or turn off enemy respawning, have lesser or more enemy drops chance) when starting a New Game and in Menu Settings for real time change.
- Made the “Save Game” accessible anywhere in the Menu with a dedicated button
- Added Quest log in the menu, it lists available quests at a certain period. Also indicating whether it’s a Normal quest, or a Limited quest.
- Added a way to purchase bombs and keys prior to the final boss, enabling players to complete all the collectibles in the game!

tags.balance_change: - Reduced the purple balls that shoot at you during the first dungeon boss fight.

tags.feature: - Route Puzzles are now saved in game so you won’t have to re-do them when you go through the dungeon.
